data.name: Mantagua Village Hotel & Cabañas
data.address: Ruta Concon hacia Quintero - F-30-E, Concón, Quintero, Valparaíso, Chile
data.description:
Set on 22-hectare grounds, this relaxed lodging is 4 km from Playa La Boca on the South Pacific Ocean and 10 km from Roca Oceanica, a seaside national park.
Ranging from rooms to cabins, the low-key quarters with wood furnishings and tile or wood floors offer satellite TV and Wi-Fi access. Some have safes.
Freebies include drinks and ice cream. Other amenities include a restaurant/bar, 2 outdoor pools (1 has a slide), a hot tub and a sauna. There's also paintball, a climbing wall, fire pits and karaoke, plus a zipline, a spa, sports fields and meeting space. Breakfast, horse rides, organized activities and parking are available.
